Business account

Open a business account.

A commercial transaction account for registered companies, partnerships, sole traders and SMEs, with face-to-face service from our branch team.

Opening depositK50
Minimum balanceK50
Monthly feeK8
TransactionsUnlimited deposits and withdrawals
StatementsDaily, monthly, quarterly, yearly or ad hoc
Book an appointment

What to bring

  • Completed NBCL Business Account Application Form
  • Business or company profile
  • IPA Certificate of Incorporation or Business Name Registration
  • IRC Tax Identification Number (TIN) certificate
  • Signed minutes or letter of authority naming signatories and how the account operates
  • Two valid IDs for every signatory, director and shareholder
  • K50 opening deposit

The same account is available as an SME Account for sole traders, partnerships and small businesses. No standard photo ID? Referee letters with a stamped statutory declaration may be accepted.

Questions

Business FAQs

Who can open a Business or SME Account?+

Registered companies, enterprises, partnerships and sole traders operating in PNG. The opening deposit is K50, which is also the minimum balance, and the monthly fee is K8.

Can I make extra loan repayments?+

Yes. Business, SME and MSME loans all allow unscheduled repayments at any time with no penalty.

Do I need collateral for a small business loan?+

Not for the MSME Loan, which offers up to K50,000 unsecured, subject to credit assessment. The SME Loan of up to K500,000 is secured.

Do EFTPoS terminals work during network outages?+

Yes. Dual SIM support with Digicel and Vodafone, plus 4G, Wi-Fi and Ethernet, lets the terminal switch networks automatically.

How are EFTPoS funds settled?+

Payments are paid out automatically every day into your linked NBCL Business or SME Account.
